series.name: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)
series.notes: Shared Voltronic-class table from official Crown PDFs. Model drift: fault 10 only on 3.6/4/5.6; fault 12 only on 3KVA TS; overload 110% (3KVA) vs 105% (3.6KW). Field 'F09'/'F51' = same as '09'/'51'. Official 55=unbalanced wins over SolarNevs DC-offset.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Fan blade jammed by dust or a wire touching it
causes.ur: Fan ka blade dust ya wire se atka hua hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC; treat DC terminals as live until the array and battery are disconnected.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC isolate karein; panel aur battery disconnect hone tak DC terminals ko live maan lein.

solutions.en: Turn the fan blade by hand and clear dust or a wire touching it; replace the fan if it is jammed or broken.
solutions.ur: Fan blade ko haath se ghuma kar dust ya phansa hua wire hatayein; fan atka ya toota ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Check the fan connector, then power on and retest; if it locks again the technician replaces the fan.
solutions.ur: Fan connector check karein, phir on karke dobara check karein; dobara atka to technician fan replace kare.

title.en: Over temperature or NTC not connected

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein
Temp sensor (NTC) dhila ya kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and let the unit cool for 10 minutes before opening it.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC isolate karein aur kholein se pehle unit ko 10 minute thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 min → on (DC isolated for DC work)
solutions.ur: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 minute → on (DC work ke liye DC isolate)

solutions.en: Clean vents and heatsink and re-seat the temperature sensor plug; if it still runs hot the sensor is replaced.
solutions.ur: Vents aur heatsink saaf karein aur temp sensor ka plug dobara lagayein; phir bhi garmi rahe to sensor replace karein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Charger output too high or battery cells failing
causes.ur: Charger ka output zyada hai ya battery cells kharab ho rahe hain

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and disconnect the battery before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi naap se pehle power off karein, AC isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter — well above the normal charge level means over-charge; check the charger output.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery voltage naap lein — normal charge level se kaafi zyada ho to over-charge hai; charger ka output check karein.

solutions.en: Stop charging if the voltage is high and have a technician check the charge circuit and relay, then retest.
solutions.ur: Voltage zyada ho to charging rok dein aur technician se charge circuit aur relay check karwayein, phir dobara check karein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged or weak with age
causes.ur: Battery geheri discharge ho gayi ya umar se kamzor ho gayi

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the battery wiring.
solutions.ur: Battery wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery resting voltage with a multimeter and charge it fully, then power on and retest.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery ki resting voltage naap lein aur use mukammal charge karein, phir on karke dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If voltage drops fast under load the battery is weak and must be replaced; also clean and tighten the terminals.
solutions.ur: Load par voltage jaldi gir jaye to battery kamzor hai aur use badalna chahiye; terminals bhi saaf karke kassein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Output short circuit or converter overheating
causes.ur: Output mein short circuit hai ya converter zyada garm ho raha hai

solutions.en: Power off at once, isolate AC and DC, and treat DC terminals as live even with breakers off.
solutions.ur: Foran power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein, aur breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load and check the output wiring for short or burn marks with the supply isolated.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karke load disconnect karein aur output wiring par short ya jale hue nishan check karein.

solutions.en: If no external short is found the converter is overheating — a technician checks cooling and internal parts before restart.
solutions.ur: Bahar koi short na mila to converter zyada garm ho raha hai — restart se pehle technician cooling aur andar ke parts check kare.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Load too heavy or output feedback faulty
causes.ur: Load zyada hai ya output feedback kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before probing the output terminals.
solutions.ur: Output terminals probe karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: After a safe restart, measure output voltage and frequency with a multimeter and compare them with the manual's normal window.
solutions.ur: Safe restart ke baad multimeter se output voltage aur frequency naap kar manual ke normal window se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the output stays out of range, check the load type and settings; a persistent fault goes to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Output range se bahar rahe to load ki qism aur settings check karein; fault lagu rahe to repair centre jayein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Load kept above 105–110% for too long
causes.ur: Load 105–110% se zyada der tak laga raha

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC, then remove the heavy load from the output.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC isolate karein, phir output se bhaari load utarein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter, keep it below the inverter rating and power on again to retest.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naap lein, inverter rating se kam rakhein aur phir on karke dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If the overload returns on a light load, a technician checks the output board and relay.
solutions.ur: Halka load par bhi overload wapas aaye to technician output board aur relay check kare.

title.en: Bus voltage too high / internal failed

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Input or grid voltage too high, or internal group failure
causes.ur: Input ya grid voltage zyada hai, ya internal group fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and DC before probing; the DC bus stays charged for some time after power off.
solutions.ur: Probe karne se pehle power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein; DC bus power off ke baad der tak charge rehta hai.

solutions.en: A technician checks the DC bus with a multimeter after safe discharge, and the input voltage feeding it.
solutions.ur: Technician safe discharge ke baad multimeter se DC bus naap le aur usko dene wali input voltage bhi check kare.

solutions.en: High grid or PV input often causes bus over-voltage; internal failure needs the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Grid ya PV input zyada hone se bus over-voltage aata hai; andar ki failure ke liye repair centre zaroori.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 4KW manual (official PDF)

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Weak battery or pre-charge circuit not working
causes.ur: Battery kamzor hai ya pre-charge circuit kaam nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and DC and do not switch on again and again.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein aur baar baar on na karein.

solutions.en: Measure input voltage and battery voltage with a multimeter before one retry — both must be in normal range.
solutions.ur: Ek baar try se pehle multimeter se input voltage aur battery voltage naap lein — dono normal range mein hone chahiye.

solutions.en: If soft start still fails, a technician checks the pre-charge circuit and relay; a repair centre may be needed.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi soft start fail ho to technician pre-charge circuit aur relay check kare; zaroorat par repair centre lage.

meaning.en: PV input over-current (3.6/4/5.6KW tables; not on 3KW).

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: PV string sized too big for this model's input limit
causes.ur: Is model ke liye PV string bohot bari hai

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and cover or disconnect the PV strings — the PV input stays live in daylight.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC isolate karein aur PV strings ko cover ya disconnect karein — din ke waqt PV input live rehta hai.

solutions.en: Check the PV string size against the model's table in the manual and reduce panels in series if it is over the limit.
solutions.ur: PV string ka size manual ki apni table se compare karein aur limit zyada ho to series mein panels kam karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the PV input wiring for shorts; if the current is still high, a technician checks the charge stage.
solutions.ur: PV input wiring mein short check karein; current phir bhi zyada rahe to technician charge stage check kare.

meaning.ur: Temp sensor ka masla — sirf Xavier 3KVA TS model par.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Temp sensor plug loose or sensor circuit open
causes.ur: Temp sensor ka plug dhila ya sensor circuit khula hai

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and let the unit cool before opening the panel.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC isolate karein aur panel kholne se pehle unit ko thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the temperature sensor plug and check that the sensor wiring is not loose or broken.
solutions.ur: Temp sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur sensor ki wiring dhili ya tooti to nahi hai check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the sensor with a multimeter — an open or very high reading means the sensor is bad and is replaced.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se sensor naap lein — open ya bohot zyada reading aaye to sensor kharab hai aur use badal dein.

source.title: Xavier 3KVA troubleshooting (ManualsLib p30)

meaning.ur: Current zyada ho gaya ya surge aa gaya.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Heavy load or voltage surge on the supply
causes.ur: Load zyada hai ya supply par voltage surge aaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and disconnect the load before checking.
solutions.ur: Check karne se pehle power off karein, AC isolate karein aur load disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter and look for storm or surge conditions on the supply.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naap lein aur supply par toofan ya surge ki halat dekhein.

solutions.en: Remove extra load and restart; if it trips again, a technician checks the output stage.
solutions.ur: Extra load hata kar restart karein; dobara trip ho to technician output stage check kare.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Input supply low or battery voltage dropped
causes.ur: Input supply kam hai ya battery voltage gir gaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and DC before probing the bus.
solutions.ur: Bus probe karne se pehle power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure input and battery voltage with a multimeter — a low battery or low input pulls the bus down.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se input aur battery voltage naap lein — battery kam ho ya input kam ho to bus neeche gir jata hai.

solutions.en: Charge or replace a weak battery or fix the supply; if the bus stays low, a technician checks the input stage.
solutions.ur: Kamzor battery charge karein ya badlein, ya supply theek karwayein; bus phir bhi kam rahe to technician input stage check kare.

meaning.ur: Internal group ka masla — repair centre le jayein.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Internal component failure on the main board
causes.ur: Main board par internal component fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and DC and do not keep restarting the unit.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein aur unit ko baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: With the supply isolated, look and smell for burnt parts, loose connectors or a blown fuse.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karke dekhein aur smell karein — jale hue parts, dhile connectors ya fuse phata hua to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Internal component failure is not a field fix — send the unit to a repair centre.
solutions.ur: Internal component ka fault mukammal theek nahi hota — unit ko repair centre bhejein.

meaning.en: Output unbalanced (official Crown wording — SolarNevs DC-offset claim loses).

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Uneven load across the output lines
causes.ur: Output lines par load barabar nahi

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the output wiring.
solutions.ur: Output wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure each output line with a multimeter or clamp meter — the readings should be balanced.
solutions.ur: Har output line ko multimeter ya clamp meter se naap lein — readings barabar honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Balance the load and check the output wiring; if it stays unbalanced, a technician checks the output board.
solutions.ur: Load barabar baant dein aur output wiring check karein; phir bhi unbalance rahe to technician output board check kare.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Sensor group feedback out of range
causes.ur: Sensor ki feedback range se bahar hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Visually check connectors and sensors for looseness or damage and re-seat them.
solutions.ur: Connectors aur sensors ko nazar se dekh kar dheele ya kharab hone ka check karein aur dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: If the fault stays, a technician checks the sensor group — a repair centre is required.
solutions.ur: Fault bani rahe to technician sensor group check kare — repair centre zaroori.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Input supply outside the inverter's working window
causes.ur: Input supply inverter ki working window se bahar hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before measuring the output.
solutions.ur: Output naapne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage with a multimeter and note whether it is low or high.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se output voltage naap lein aur note karein ke kam hai ya zyada.

solutions.en: Check the input supply and load balance; an abnormal output that persists needs the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Input supply aur load balance check karein; output theek na rahe to repair centre zaroori.

meaning.en: String Voc beyond limit — reduce series.
meaning.ur: String Voc limit se bahar — series kam.

causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Too many panels in series for the string limit
causes.ur: String limit se zyada panels series mein lage hain

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and cover the PV strings before working on the PV input.
solutions.ur: PV input par kaam se pehle power off karein, AC isolate karein aur PV strings ko cover karein.

solutions.en: Measure the string open-circuit voltage (Voc) with a multimeter — it must stay within the manual's limit.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se string ka open-circuit voltage (Voc) naap lein — manual ki limit ke andar rehna chahiye.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of panels in series until Voc is within limit, then power on and retest.
solutions.ur: Voc limit ke andar aane tak series mein panels kam karein, phir on karke dobara check karein.

title.en: High AC input >280VAC during BUS soft start
title.ur: BUS soft start par AC input >280VAC

meaning.en: Source-side high voltage during bus soft start — WAPDA/neutral issue, not inverter fault.
meaning.ur: BUS soft start par source-side high voltage — WAPDA/neutral masla, inverter fault nahi.

causes.ur: Utility zyada / neutral gayab
Tap/ghalat supply

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and isolate AC before measuring the supply voltage.
solutions.ur: Supply voltage naapne se pehle inverter power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the input voltage at the inverter terminals with a multimeter; also check the main breaker and neutral wiring.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke terminals par multimeter se input voltage naap lein; main breaker aur neutral wiring bhi check karein.

solutions.en: If the utility voltage is high or the neutral is lost, keep the inverter off and file a DISCO complaint until supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Utility voltage zyada ho ya neutral gayab ho to inverter band rakhein aur supply theek hone tak DISCO ki complaint karein.
